description: This file defines action creator functions for a Redux-based React application, managing to-do items by exporting functions that create action objects for various CRUD operations and state toggles.

methods.name: addTodo
methods.description: Creates an action object to add a new to-do item with specified text.

methods.name: deleteTodo
methods.description: Creates an action object to delete a to-do item by ID.

methods.name: editTodo
methods.description: Creates an action object to edit an existing to-do item's text by ID.

methods.name: toggleTodo
methods.description: Creates an action object to toggle the completion status of a to-do item by ID.

methods.name: toggleAll
methods.description: Creates an action object to toggle all to-do items' completion status.

methods.name: clearCompleted
methods.description: Creates an action object to clear all completed to-do items.

ctags.name: editTodo
ctags.pattern: /^export const editTodo = (id, text) => ({ type: types.EDIT_TODO, id, text });$/
